text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: gpu_utilization_pool:euw1 at 98% (threshold 90%). Autoscaler attempted 6 provisions, 6x quotaExceeded. sample log: `PROVISION_FAIL project=redwood-prod region=europe-west1 reason=QUOTA_EXCEEDED GPU=16` :rotating_light:
Priya Singh: I'm on it — picking up pager. Can someone confirm customer impact?
Mateo Rivera: Seeing queue growth on inference-route /v1/generate in eu-west1. Queue length +1200 in last 10m, p50 latency climbing from 120ms -> 1.3s. No errors returned yet, requests are pending.
Alice Chen: alerting product/signal: initial customers in EU experiencing timeouts around 30s. Not all traffic; canary routes are ok in eu-west4.
oncall-metrics-bot: metric snapshot: autoscaler.pending_pods=420, autoscaler.provision_attempts=6, gpu_quota.available=0/200 per-project.
Samir Patel: Confirming GCP returned `QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA' per project`. There was a recent batch rollout that temporarily reserved extra GPUs for offline fine-tuning — may have consumed headroom.
Priya Singh: Ok plan: 1) triage and see if reserved batch job can be paused 2) fail traffic to eu-west4 for non-critical routes 3) open support ticket to raise quota 4) local mitigations (reduce batch size, enable CPU fallbacks). Assigning tasks.
Mateo Rivera: I can run quick check on reserved jobs. Running gcloud list: ```gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels=batch=true AND zone:(europe-west1-*)" --format="table(name,machineType,status)"```
Mateo Rivera: Found 12 batch instances with GPUs allocated by nightly-finetune job. They show status RUNNING. Job id: finetune-2026-03-15-04.
Alice Chen: Product impact: three paying customers on strict latency SLAs show saw 5-10% error rates due to upstream timeouts. We should prepare PSAT message if mitigation >30m.
Samir Patel: I'm going to attempt a throttle on batch pipeline to release GPUs: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/ft-worker -n batch-jobs` (will coordinate with ML team).
Priya Singh: @Samir please wait 30s until we confirm autoscaler retry events, we might avoid hard stop if GCP throttling transient.
Incident Bot: AUTOSCALER: retrying provisioning in europe-west1: attempt=7 -> failure QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
Mateo Rivera: Paging ML infra owner @ml-ops — need confirmation to pause finetune.
Priya Singh: If we pause batch, we lose training progress but reduce customer impact. I vote pause.
Samir Patel: Paused ft-worker replicas. GPUs freed = 48 according to `gcloud compute` refresh.
oncall-metrics-bot: gpu_quota.available updated: 48/200. autoscaler.retry_count reset? still pending pods 312.
Mateo Rivera: Triggering a manual autoscaler re-check: `curl -XPOST https://infra.internal/autoscaler/reconcile?region=europe-west1`
Incident Bot: AUTOSCALER: reconcile triggered by user Mateo Rivera. Provision loop restarted.
Incident Bot: PROVISION_SUCCESS after reconcile: allocated 10 GPUs (node-group-euw1-burst-1). Pending pods drained -> queue decreasing.
Alice Chen: Latency p50 back to ~170ms for routed traffic — good sign. Queue length dropping from 1200 -> 400 in 7m.
Priya Singh: Good. Next: open GCP support ticket to request quota raise to 400 GPUs for project so we don't hit this again with overlapping batch jobs. Samir, can you file with logs?
Samir Patel: Filed support case 2026-03-15-9812: "quota increase request - GPUs europe-west1" attached provisioning logs and project usage. GCP Support Bot acknowledged with SR#987654. ETA currently 3-5 business days.
Mateo Rivera: In parallel: change traffic routing rules to send non-critical inference to eu-west4 until quota stable. Patching router: ```json
PATCH /routing/service-config
{ "rules": [{"path":"/v1/generate","priority":20,"region_pref":"eu-west4","criteria":"non-critical"} ] }
```
Alice Chen: Product approved fallback to CPU for non-interactive bulk jobs. We need a quick flag flip in feature-gates.
Priya Singh: Add mitigations summary for postmortem: - paused batch jobs to free GPUs - manual reconcile triggered - temporary region reroute for low-priority traffic - filed quota increase with GCP - prepared customer comms if >30m impact
Mateo Rivera: Also lowering autoscaler min_gpu_per_node to allow smaller nodes (hotfix): `config autoscaler: min_gpus_per_node: 1 -> 0` — this will allow packing to CPU-only nodes as stopgap. Deployed.
Incident Bot: NOTIFICATION: autoscaler config hotfix applied by Mateo Rivera.
Samir Patel: Communicated to ML team: resumed finetune paused nodes will be requeued once quota available. ML team acknowledged.
Priya Singh: Customer comms draft (short): "We experienced elevated inference latency in Europe (europe-west1) due to GPU provisioning constraints. We have freed capacity, rerouted non-critical traffic, and are working with our cloud provider to increase quotas. If you're seeing degraded performance, please reach support." Approve to send?
Alice Chen: Approved. Send via status page and email for impacted customers listed in ticket.
GCP Support Bot: Update: SR#987654 - quota increase approved to 320 GPUs for project redwood-prod in europe-west1. Change window scheduled 2026-03-15T20:30Z (within 5 hours).
Priya Singh: Great. Schedule follow-ups: 1) Postmortem to eng-sre and ml-ops 2) Add guardrail: auto-alert if batch job requests >30% of regional GPU quota 3) Add runbook step to prefer pausing batch before manual quotas hit.
Mateo Rivera: I'll make the autoscaler more quota-aware: if available_quota < needed_provision then fallback to region routing earlier.
Priya Singh: Closing notes: incident resolved to mitigated state. We'll keep monitoring next 24h and update status page when quota change is live.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring.
